links.comparator_used: Geometric-only comparison of primary and independent verification auto-contouring models (DSC, surface DSC, 95% Hausdorff distance, mean surface distance) without dose metrics
links.outcome: Ability of the verification model comparison to flag dosimetric errors in the primary auto-contours (D_error, mean and D_error, max), measured by ROC-AUC and AUPRC in the test set
links.effect: Adding dose metrics increased ROC-AUC and AUPRC for D_error,mean in H&N small structures. For D_error,max it increased performance for H&N small, H&N medium and GYN structures. No numeric values given in the abstract, and gains were not reported for all structure groups.
links.quote: In many instances, utilizing dose with geometric comparisons can improve the ability of a verification model to flag potential errors from a primary auto-contouring model.

design_hint: automated QA using a second independent auto-contouring model with dose comparison
